gap: No result ChatGPT got pairs Minn Kota's statement that QUEST motors pull up to 60 A on high speed with the fact that lithium packs sold for big motors, such as Redodo's 36V 50Ah 'for 100-120 lb' (50 A BMS, 60 A for only 30 minutes), sit below that ceiling, so the BMS can cut power at full throttle or during Spot-Lock in wind.
standout_why: I read the cited Minn Kota pages: Power Considerations (#4), Deep Cycle Battery Selection (#5) and Amp Draw/Circuit Breakers, plus the uncited Lithium Selection page (#6). They give the general rule that the battery's continuous discharge must cover the motor's max amp draw, and ChatGPT's answer repeats it ('confirm that the BMS supports the motor's maximum current draw'). None of those pages lists a number in text, because the amp-draw and breaker charts are images. None names a battery that fails the rule. ChatGPT's own chart suggests '24V 50-100Ah' for 55-70 lb motors and '36V 100Ah' for 80-112 lb, with no current spec, so a shopper could buy a 50Ah-class pack that the BMS limits. I could not open the QUEST manuals in the results (#7 and #8 were over 10 MB, #16 returned 403), so I can't rule out that they print the 60 A figure. That is why this scores 2 and not 3.
kit_items: battery: Redodo 24V 100Ah LiFePO4 (100 A BMS, 2,560 Wh, Redodo rates it for 70-100 lb trolling motors). One pack replaces two 12V batteries in series, and its 100 A BMS is well above the 60 A Minn Kota says a QUEST motor pulls on high. The 24V 50Ah is rated 60 A for only 30 minutes, which is a marginal match.

charger: Redodo 29.2V 20A MINI LiFePO4 charger. Redodo's own product page says the 24V 100Ah 'fully recharges in just 5 hours with a 20A (29.2V) LiFePO4 charger'. Minn Kota PCL onboard chargers top out at 14.5 V per bank and the battery maker has to confirm compatibility, so a separate lithium charger avoids that question.
breaker: 60 A maximum for a QUEST install (Minn Kota: do not use breakers over 60 A on QUEST). Redodo does not sell one, so the shopper has to buy it separately.

findings.product: Minn Kota QUEST motors (Ultrex/Terrova/Riptide Instinct QUEST)
findings.label: Current draw on high speed
findings.source_title: Trolling Motor Amp Draw, Circuit Breakers, Fuses, and Extending the Battery Leads – Minn Kota
findings.note: Text: QUEST motors are 'designed to not pull more than 60 amps on high speed'. The same article says breakers over 60 A should not be used on QUEST installs. This article was not in ChatGPT's results.

findings.label: What happens when the battery's continuous rating is below the motor's max draw
findings.value: BMS restricts power; the motor may shut off, turn on without spinning the prop, or have steering, i-Pilot and Spot-Lock problems
findings.source_title: Lithium Battery Selection and Recommendations – Minn Kota
findings.note: Rival result #6 (uncited) and cited #4 and #5 give the rule but no number in text, because the charts are images.

findings.product: general (brushed Minn Kota motors on lithium)
findings.label: Speed limit on lithium
findings.source_title: Lithium Battery Selection and Recommendations – Minn Kota
findings.note: 'Running the motor at maximum speed with lithium batteries can result in damage.' Rivals already state this, so it does not count as a gap.

findings.label: Max charge voltage
findings.source_title: Lithium Battery Selection and Recommendations – Minn Kota
findings.note: Minn Kota tells owners to confirm that 14.5 V meets the battery maker's spec. Redodo's 12V chargers output 14.6 V, so an existing Minn Kota onboard charger may not fully charge a Redodo LiFePO4 without the battery maker's OK. Rival #6 has this.

findings.label: BMS / continuous discharge vs marketed thrust
findings.value: 50 A BMS, steady 50 A; 60 A for up to 30 min; 250 A peak; sold 'for trolling motors with 100-120 lbs of thrust'
findings.source_title: Redodo 36V 50Ah Lithium Trolling Motor Battery for 36V Trolling Motors with 100-120 lbs
findings.note: Read from the store's product data via storecheck (later product fetches returned HTTP 429). Price $359.99. 50 A continuous < 60 A QUEST high-speed draw, so this is the trap combination.

findings.label: Continuous discharge vs marketed thrust
findings.value: 60 A continuous for 30 minutes; 'for 24V trolling motors with up to 100 lbs'
findings.source_title: Redodo 24V 50Ah Bluetooth Lithium Trolling Motor Battery
findings.note: Store data via storecheck. Price $254.99. It just meets the 60 A ceiling, but only for 30 minutes.

findings.label: BMS / expansion / charger
findings.value: 100 A BMS; 2,560 Wh; max 4P2S; recharges in 5 h with a 20 A (29.2 V) LiFePO4 charger; 45.59 lb; rated for 70-100 lb trolling motors
findings.source_title: Redodo 24V 100Ah LiFePO4 Lithium Battery | Marine, RV, Solar Home, Home Backup
findings.note: Store data via storecheck. Price $469.99. 100 A ≥ 60 A QUEST draw, so it clears the BMS trap.

findings.product: Redodo 24V 100Ah Group 31 Trolling Motor Bluetooth Lithium Battery
